heuristics.extrapolation: Extrapolates single-trial distinguished-point collision behavior of the 783-operation r=54 Poseidon step function F_{rho_0}(x) on the origin-shifted BBLP 2-round affine input line W_{rho_0}(x) = (rho_0 * x - d_0) mod p from the executed reduced widths w in {10, 14} to the full 255-bit prime field F_p across 60 algebraic rounds (degree 5^60).
heuristics.limitations: Reduced-width truncation tests low-bit projections of the full-field permutation rather than full 255-bit field collisions (which require ~2^{126.21} compressions and are computationally infeasible to execute directly); random-mapping behavior at full width remains a standard cryptographic heuristic rather than an unconditional theorem.
heuristics.scope: Applies to Lemma 3 random-mapping lower bound P_succ >= 1 - sum_{i=1}^8 e_i = 0.390002380626 >= 0.39 for the iterated walk x_t = F_{rho_0}(x_{t-1}) with independent uniform trial coins (rho_0, x_0) in F_p^* x F_p.
heuristics.statement: For a uniformly chosen trial coin rho_0 in F_p^* and starting point x_0 in F_p, the trail generated by the 783-operation step function F_{rho_0}(x) on the origin-shifted BBLP 2-round affine input line W_{rho_0}(x) = (rho_0 * x - d_0) mod p satisfies the success probability lower bound of Lemma 3 (P_succ >= 0.390002380626 >= 0.39) derived for a uniform random mapping on F_p.
